body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/30322

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2379

## What I did

Investigated the decode-restart failure signature with decode radix cache and HiCache. The prepared source already contains asynchronous restore gating: network transfer success remains hidden while L3/L2 restoration is pending, L3 prefetch completion is checked before load-back, and restored indices are committed only after the load-back event completes. The upstream PR referenced by the issue remains open and was not merged.

Added three focused regression cases for the exact L1=0/L2=0/L3=64 shape: incomplete prefetch stays pending without load-back; complete prefetch queues all 64 indices; and transport success remains gated until restore is READY. Added the required investigation report and raw evidence under `reports/j-7ad70ba0d1db/`.

## Reproduce

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-7ad70ba0d1db/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_decode_hicache_tree_core.py test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_decode_queue_cleanup.py test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_decode_radix_lock_ref.py
```

Result: 25 passed.

## Limitations

The original deployment requires eight H20 decode ranks, eight prefill CP ranks, Mooncake transfer, persistent HiCache storage, model weights, and a decode-process restart. This job supplied one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 and no model/storage fixture, so I did not claim a full serving, NVIDIA, CP=8/DP=8, persistent-storage, or process-restart reproduction. The tests validate the control-flow invariant and index coverage, not Mooncake hardware transport, model semantics, or a distributed workload. No native component was changed or rebuilt.
